action.name: Padless HyperBoost Steel Nomad reviewed-load dwell
action.value: Exact-hash externally launched Steel Nomad workload observed for thirty two-second HyperBoost safety samples, followed by exact Balanced restoration

validation.applyResult: Applied successfully once from the confirmed Balanced and Automatic baseline.
validation.readbackResult: Confirmed paired HyperBoost mode 7, exact workload identity, required GPU telemetry, and safety limits throughout all thirty samples.
validation.restorationResult: Restored successfully once to the saved Balanced pair after the full reviewed-load dwell.
validation.restorationReadbackResult: Confirmed exact Balanced restoration and fresh post-restoration cooling-pad absence.

sanitizedEvidence.summary: The validator bound the operator-launched Steel Nomad executable by exact name and SHA-256 and revalidated it throughout the run; OpenBlade did not launch or stop the workload.
Thirty of thirty samples completed with continuous physical pad absence, FullPower330W, paired mode 7, CPU and GPU telemetry, and both laptop fans above the reviewed 2000 RPM minimum.
The validator restored the exact saved Balanced pair once, confirmed it, and reconfirmed pad absence without retry or manual recovery.
The successful run used the exact repaired PR head whose WDDM activity source primes its read-only counter before the first telemetry decision.

limitations: This validates one 60-second Steel Nomad workload window and does not establish every workload, ambient condition, or long-duration thermal envelope.
The platform CPU-side EC thermal input remained 45 C; it is not per-core DTS telemetry and is interpreted only according to the reviewed plan.
The result is scoped to RZ09-0581 BIOS 4.00, Balanced and Automatic, FullPower330W, and confirmed pad absence.
Installed-service low-power and unexpected-exit recovery remain unvalidated, so production padless HyperBoost remains disabled.

productionAdmission.reason: The reviewed external-load gate passed, but adapter-transition and installed-service lifecycle gates remain independently required.

notes: A prior run on 0f56b0c1 safely aborted after the first post-apply sample because an unprimed WDDM counter reported GPU temperature unavailable; it restored Balanced with no indeterminate write and is not used as positive evidence.
Commit 18bd0017 primes the read-only WDDM activity counter; Service tests passed 1247 of 1247 and Capture tests passed 456 of 456 before this successful rerun.
USBPcap was not running, and no Razer service was started, stopped, or restored by the validator.
